label: Iron Man
description: Smug, fast-talking, and quite sure the car would be better if he had built it.
direction: Speak fast, dry and smug, like a genius billionaire who is bored of being right: quick sarcastic asides, effortless confidence. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Tony Stark in the film register: the sarcasm is in the asides, never in the instruction itself. The voice model is not chosen yet, so `voice` is the placeholder TBD.

rights.source_work: Tales of Suspense number 39 and the Marvel Studios films
rights.author: Marvel Comics (character created by Stan Lee, Larry Lieber, Don Heck and Jack Kirby)
rights.pd_basis: None. Marvel, now part of Disney, holds copyright and trademark in the character. Robert Downey Jr. defined the screen voice from 2008 and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Robert Downey Jr.'s.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Not bad, kid.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. I did the math.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Try to keep up.
lines.start_drive_1: I am Iron Man. And I am your navigator. You're welcome.
lines.start_drive_2: Genius, billionaire, philanthropist, and today, your sat nav.
lines.start_drive_3: Jarvis, start the car. Fine, I'll do it myself.
lines.start_drive_4: Let's go. I've got a board meeting I plan to skip.
lines.start_drive_5: Nice car. I'd have added repulsors, but it's fine.
lines.start_drive_6: Buckle up. I built this route in a cave, with a box of scraps.
lines.start_drive_7: Sometimes you gotta drive before you can walk.
lines.start_drive_8: Suit's in the shop, so we're driving. Try to keep up.
lines.start_drive_9: Tony Stark here. The route is optimized. Obviously.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Not my fault. I'm never wrong.
lines.arrived: We're here. I am Iron Man. You're welcome.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Trust me.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Who designed this?
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. I'd fly over it. You, sadly, cannot.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Careful. Not everyone has a suit.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Jarvis flagged it. I'm taking the credit.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. I could buy the camera, but just slow down.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Even I stop for those. Sometimes.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Relax, I know a guy. Still, slow down.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed it. Bold move. Running a better route now.
